items.issue: The working-tree artifacts and source are not publisher/signed-tag signed.
items.workaround: Sign the exact qualified commit and final binaries in protected release infrastructure.

items.issue: Build-host portable smoke passed; clean-VM install/repair/update/rollback/uninstall remains external.
items.workaround: Run the supplied matrix on disposable Windows x64 VMs.

items.issue: One thousand aggregate wall-clock beta/automation hours are not present in this local workspace.
items.workaround: Collect signed, deduplicated session evidence before Stable approval.

items.issue: RustSec reports allowed unmaintained/unsound notices in transitive crates although both lockfiles have zero known vulnerabilities.
items.workaround: Keep the Windows Tier-1 graph patched, retain Linux as Experimental, and replace affected upstream chains when compatible releases exist.

items.issue: Vite reports shared static/dynamic modules and two chunks above its advisory threshold.
items.workaround: Use the qualified bundles; profile before splitting these tightly shared editor/recovery paths.

items.issue: Linux/macOS are not promoted without matching-host evidence.
items.workaround: Keep their Experimental badges and build on matching hosts.

items.issue: Networking remains an optional Experimental package.
items.workaround: Do not treat it as a 4.0 core guarantee.
